notes.title: Worms W.M.D 12 Month Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hey Community,

The time has come for us to share our Worms W.M.D Roadmap with you!

Since the game’s launch in August we’ve been working hard planning out what content to bring to the game. The roadmap has gone through a few iterations and versions in both deciding what it should contain as well as what we should prioritise. 

The order in which we add content to the game was settled on after combining your feedback along with our vision for the game and what we can feasibly do in the given time.

Some of the information will be more detailed than others, this is intentional as we keep back some surprises and finalise a few more dates and details. There will also be some things entirely hidden and we’ll spring them on you nearer the time.

Thank you all for your support since the game’s launch, this is a journey we’re excited to share with you and we look forward to your feedback!

Other than the different quarters all information listed below is in no particular order.


[h1]Quarter 1 2017[/h1]

[b]Cross Platform Play[/b]

To ensure a smooth release of cross platform play between PC, Mac and Linux we’ve decided to push this out after Christmas. This was decided as the last thing we want is to push out this update and have it break multiplayer whilst everyone is away on holiday. 

We’re excited to get this out and in the wild so don’t expect to have to wait long once things get rolling again in January.

[b]Ranked Relaunch[/b]

Ranked is being rebooted and relaunched, bigger, better, bolder…and fairer!
[list]
[*]Improved Matchmaking – New matchmaking that will ensure more fair, competitive matchups.
[*]Points awarded/lost differ depending on the skill gap with your opponent.
[*]A new league style progression system & worldwide ranking.
[*]Upgraded ranked profile page and ways to show off your ranked status in-game.
[*]New, tiered ranked rewards that add new ways to cosmetically show off your skill both in and out of game.
[*]New loading screens for ranked matches.
[*]The (potential) retiring of the Gold Bazooka & Silver Grenade skins – these will become legacy and exclusive to players who had earned them prior to the changes.
[/list]



[b]Increased level cap and new rewards[/b]

More XP levels and more cool unlocks!

[b]AI in Online Multiplayer[/b]

It’s coming! Due to player feedback this has been reprioritised from quarter 2 to quarter 1.

[b]Design a crafted weapon and get it in-game[/b]

We’ll be launching a competition to get you to design a craftable upgrade for one of the 4 new Liberation weapons. The winning design will be implemented into the full game!

[b]Hat Editor – Steam Workshop[/b]

More power to you, the creatives types in the community! Curate and share your player made hats on the Steam Workshop to be used in-game.

[b]Crafted Weapons in Scheme Stage 2[/b]

We’ll be expanding crafted weapons in a scheme to give you more variety, flexibility and control over what happens in a match.

[b]Deeper Scheme Options[/b]

More varied options for existing schemes and potentially a few more options for you to play with.

[b]FORT MODE[/b]

Exactly what is says on the tin. We’ve got exciting plans for this and look forward to sharing them with you and getting your input nearer the time.



[h1]Quarter 2 2017[/h1]

[b]New Theme[/b]

This update will include a new theme, customisation and weapons. You can expect a mix of brand new and classic weapons to make an appearance. 

[b]Holiday Customisation items[/b]

Hats and more!

[b]Building Editor – Steam Workshop[/b]

More details on this coming nearer the time.

[b]New Theme[/b]

A new theme including new weapons and customisation.

[b]Increased level cap and rewards[/b]

More rewards for those in the higher echelons of levels.



[h1]Quarter 3 – 2017[/h1]

[b]Summer Customisation Pack[/b]

More hats and gravestones!

[b]Soundbank Editor – Steam Workshop[/b]

Bring your dulcet tones or those of your desires into the game through the Steam Workshop.

This is subject to change.

[b]Scheme Workshop Integration[/b]

More information on what this entails will be revealed closer to the time of launch.

This is subject to change.



[h1]Quarter 4 – 2017[/h1]

[b]New Theme[/b]

A new theme including weapons and customisation!

[b]Increased level cap and rewards[/b]

You know the drill by now!


[b]Holiday Customisation[/b]

Hats and gravestones!



There you have it, the Worms W.M.D Roadmap up until December 2017. 

We’ve been really keen to share this with you and really look forward to your feedback and engaging with you on this.

notes.title: Worms W.M.D: Liberation Update - Live Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/0d85c7bc280eda6e10aba40e1c3399c7c7b80237.gif[/img]
Community, the free Liberation update has arrived, marking the biggest update to come to Worms W.M.D since the game launched!

Check out the post below to discover what brand new free content awaits you as well as a whole host of bug fixes, including a fix for 21:9, weapon tweaks and balance changes. 

Oh and you can now choose up to 5 crafted weapons to add to your scheme!

[h1]Liberation: A Whole new theme to play with which includes bunker and tunnel systems[/h1]
[list]
[*]5 brand new single player missions
[*]4 brand new weapons including the Tasty Worm Lick, Worm Stinger, Drone and W1 Rocket
[*]A brand new vehicle that can travel on water; The Drillboat
[*]Over 10 brand new buildings specific to the new Liberation update, which also include Bunkers and Tunnels.
[*]12 new customisations
[/list]
 
[h1]Additional Features and Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new scheme to allow up to 5 crafted weapons to be used from the start (Stage 1)
[*]Global Chat player list now shows players who are in active battle with their annelids
[/list]

[b]New Scheme[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new ESL scheme to allow players to easily practise this scheme between tournaments. 
[*]Reordered the scheme list to bump the most popular schemes up the list.
[/list]

[b]Pro / Ranked scheme[/b]
[list]
[*]Disabled crafting crates so that both players are on an equal footing when crafting items and given both players more crafting materials to compensate for the change
[*]Starting craft materials changed from 2/2/0/0 to 8/6/1/0
[*]Craft crate drops set to 0% chance
[/list]
 
[b]Crates Drops[/b]
[list]
[*]Crate drop speed has been increased to allow for faster turn transitions.
[*]Drop Height (from ground) increased from 300 to 1200
[*]Drop speed increased from 7.5 to 12
[/list]
 
[b]Weapon Tweaks[/b]

Banana Bomb & Super Variant
[list]
[*]Increased the spread of the chained payloads from the Banana Bomb and Super variant.
[*]Banana Bomb ChainedPower increased from 45 to 55
[*]Super Banana Bomb ChainedPower increased from 45 to 55
[/list]
Helicopter
[list]
[*]Reduced damage output of the Helicopter and made it more difficult to reach higher damage values. This vehicle’s utility still lies heavily in its mobility.
[*]Min and max shock range 70/80 to 50/80
[*]Min and max shock damage 2/3 to 1/2
[*]MaxRepeatDamage 70 to 50
[/list]
Vehicle mine
[list]
[*]Vehicle Mine has a vehicle damage multiplier. It is now deadlier against vehicles and not as strong against worms.
[*]Vehicle damage mod x4
[*]Reduced shock min & max range 525/540 to 60/410 (including push)
[*]Initial shock changed from 60 to 25 damage
[*]Reduced push from 50 to 30
[/list]
Sentry Gun / Sentry Gun Lite
[list]
[*]Adjusted turn speed and reaction rate of Sentry Gun to allow for easier counter-play with this weapon when ‘trapped’ by it.  Also adjusted maximum damage so that this weapon is less of an all-in-one solution and more specialised to area denial.
[*]Maximum bullet damage changed from 50 to 30
[*]Tracking Speed reduced slightly
[*]Warm up time increased slightly
[/list]
Luzi
[list]
[*]The Uzi crafted variants have been rebalanced. They were capable of too much damage with very easy to meet conditions to get the best out of them.
[*]Reduced damage per bullet from 6 to 5
[*]Reduced maximum bullet damage to 50
[*]Reduced shots fired from 12 to 10
[*]Removed explosive damage from the final bounce
[/list]
Minigun
[list]
[*]Reduced maximum damage from 70 to 60
[/list]
Sheep Launcher
[list]
[*]The Sheep Launcher has had its launch power increased to allow it to cover a larger area of the landscape.
[*]Launch power increased from 24 to 36
[/list]
Crafting Costs

We have made lots of adjustments to the crafting costs of weapons. The goal of this was to encourage the use of more weapon variations and reduce the cost variance between weapons of similar power/type. Weapon variations that have a small power increase now cost a premium in the first two crafting tiers (Poison Dynamite is a good example of this) , whereas weapon variations that jump up a power band will have a tier 3 or 4 premium added to their cost (Mega Buster is a good example of this).

(Boggy’s Special Sauce / Sticky Donkey Paste / Banana Bomb Seeds / Tears of a Worm)
[list]
[*]Wormageddon 8/8/8/2 to 8/6/4/2
[*]Angry Donkey 8/8/8/2 to 8/6/4/2
[*]OMG LOL 8/8/8/2/ to 8/6/4/2
[*]Armageddon 8/8/4/2 to 8/4/4/2
[*]Concrete Donkey 8/8/4/2 to 8/4/4/2
[*]OMG 8/8/4/2 to 8/4/4/2
[*]Super Flatulence Sheep 8/4/4/1 to 8/6/2/1
[*]Liberty Strike 8/4/4/1 to 8/6/2/1
[*]Stinking Carpet Bomb 8/4/4/1 to 8/6/2/1
[*]Super Banana bomb 8/8/2/1 to 8/6/2/1
[*]Mega Buster 4/2/2/1 to 8/4/2/1
[*]Ming Vase 4/2/1/1 to 8/4/2/1
[*]Holy Mine Grenade 8/4/4/1 to 8/4/2/1
[*]Turkey Bomb 8/8/2/1 to 8/6/1/0
[*]Agile Old Lady 4/4/1/1 to 8/6/1/0
[*]TF2 Sentry Gun 4/2/2/0 to 8/6/1/0
[*]Demon Strike 6/2/2/0 to 8/6/1/0
[*]Orcs Must Die 4/2/2/1 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Holy Hand Grenade 8/4/2/1 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Old Lady 4/2/1/1 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Triple Bunker Buster 4/2/2/0 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Dodgy Charged Battery 4/2/2/0 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Really Unwanted Present 4/2/2/1 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Jetpack Droptank 4/4/2/0 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Mine Strike 6/2/2/0 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Electric Sheep 4/2/2/1 to 8/4/1/0
[*]Alloy Baseball Bat 4/2/2/0 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Flaming Bat 4/2/2/0 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Sheep on a Long Rope 4/4/1/1 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Sheep Launcher 4/4/1/1 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Unwanted Present 4/2/1/1 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Jetpack 4/2/2/0 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Sentry Gun Lite 4/2/2/0 to 4/4/1/0
[*]BBQ Sheep 4/2/2/1 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Poison Dynamite 4/2/2/0 to 4/4/1/0
[*]Airstrike 6/2/1/0 to 8/2/1/0
[*]Bunker Buster 4/2/1/0 to 8/2/1/0
[*]Goat on a Rope 4/4/1/1 to 4/2/1/0
[*]Sheep on a Rope 4/2/1/1 to 4/2/1/0
[*]Triple Barrel Shotgun 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Training Shotgun 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Bazooka Pie 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Gas Grenade 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Luzi 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Minigun 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*] Cluster Bomb MK2 4/2/0/0 to 4/4/0/0
[*]Vehicle Mine 4/2/0/0 to 2/2/0/0
[*]Kamikaze 4/2/0/0 to 2/2/0/0
[/list]

We will be keeping an eye out for your feedback on these changes as we strive to get the best version of the Ranked scheme as possible.

Bug Fixes and Improvements
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the game from being displayed correctly in 21:9
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing issues when switching between QWERTY and AZERTY keyboard layouts
[*]Added a fancy new loading screen for User Generated Content landscapes made in the Editor
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a crash for some players during the boot flow
[*]Fixed an issue which caused slight desyncs on online matches when using OMG
[*]Fixed a text issue for camera direction and strike controls in non-English languages
[*]Fixed an issue which incorrectly showed player stats in online lobby
[*]Fixed an issue for theme names in drop down menu which defaulted to the top of the list
[*]Fixed an issue where the cursor would disappear following inactivity on the frontend
[*]Fixed an issue which would highlight where enemy worms were positioned inside buildings
[*]Fixed an issue when using Page Down on lists
[*]Fixed a graphical corruption issue some users experienced during the boot flow
[*]Fixed an issue which caused graphical issues when changing resolution whilst in fullscreen
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the cursor to jump around during Teleport In on multiplayer matches
[*]Fixed an issue which caused timers to flicker if idle whilst using Worm Select
[*]Fixed an issue which could prevent the 'Default' button working correctly in Video Settings
[*]Fixed an issue where some users would see duplicate resolutions
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented settings from saving correctly via Unsaved Changes prompt
[*]Fixed an issue when zooming in when running the game in 5k
[*]Fixed a crash after using the banana bomb and ninja rope in the following turn
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the list updating correctly when using mouse then controllers
[*]Fixed an issue in the editor which allowed the camera to zoom through the imported image
[*]Fixed an issue where users could attack multiple times when disconnecting and reconnecting the ninja rope…oops!
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the idle animation playing when using the shotgun with laser sight
[*]Fixed an issue where certain samples from the speechbanks weren't always being triggered
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented rope knocking from working
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the camera to move instead of the worm when using arrow keys
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented read only mode from working when pressing the Tilde key
[*]Fixed an issue which allowed replays to be dismissed with any button on the controller
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Blowtorch to stop too early
[*]Fixed an issue where debug text could be seen in the fuse time description
[*]Fixed an issue where the landscape generator would always default to Rainforest when returning from a lobby
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the turn from handing over if a mine was placed on a static gun that was occupied by a worm
[*]Fixed an issue where some users could hear elements of the game in the results screen
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the magnets from deploying when on a jetpack
[*]Fixed an issue which allowed worms to be hit by the Baseball Bat when stood behind the attacking worm
[*]Fixed an issue where the replay audio could be heard even when replays are disabled
[*]Fixed an issue where the countdown timer could be heard when using an airstrike
[*]Fixed an issue in Global Chat which prevented users from seeing text that is deleted when exceeding 40+ characters
[*]Fixed an issue which caused text to move off screen in the Lobby Chat
[*]Fixed an issue where the Mech could pause in mid air when attempting to jump whilst falling
[*]Fixed an issue where the audio for an active mine played too long when in the water
Values for delayed weapons will now display in grey
[*]Fixed navigation issues in the Settings menu
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the camera from following the worm when using Worm Select
[*]Fixed an issue which stopped players from changing the fuse length when using it as a secondary weapon
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the camera from following the Sentry Gun Lite when it's thrown
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the Blowtorch from blowing up barrels when used from above
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the winning team from performing their victory dances in-game
[*]Fixed an issue the the Luzi laser beam origin point from being in the wrong position
[*]Fixed an issue where audio for the Dynamite could still be heard when navigating back to the frontend
[*]Fixed an issue where players couldn't hear the background and Teleport In audio
[*]Fixed an issue where the Static Gun would still be visible after it's been destroyed
[*]Fixed an issue which made the Sentry Gun jump when hit with flames
[*]Fixed an issue where animated elements could be seen through the land
[*]Fixed an issue where subtitles wouldn't appear on videos for OSX and Linux
[*]Fixed an issue where the [ and ] buttons were reveresed on OSX and Linux
[*]Fixed an issue which would trigger the screensaved whilst usinr a controller on OSX
[*]Fixed an issue which made the game unresponsive when using CMD+Q on OSX
[*]Fixed an issue where the resolution wasn't saved after closing the game on OSX
[*]Fixed on issue on OSX which would cause the cursor to behave erratically when a controller was connected
[/list]

We'll have more exciting news coming for you all next week, so watch this space!

Let us know what you think of the update in the official discussion thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/327030/discussions/0/152391285458179186/]here[/url].

notes.title: Worms WMD adds free Liberation update
notes.notes:
The Worms game Tom billed as "a love letter to Armageddon", Worms WMD is a cordial throwback to the team-based strategy 'em up's roots. Its latest incoming update—Liberation—is free and adds a wealth of new tools, weapons and vehicles to help destroy its handful of new levels. 

Free to download as of December 7, WMD's Liberation update adds five new single-player level; four new weapons, including the Mischievous Drone, the W1 Rocket, the Worm Stinger, and the Tasty Worm Lick; and 12 new customisation options, like the Bicorne, Beret, Chinese Hat, and Rubber Glove. 

On top of that, the update adds a new theme "to battle upon including new buildings and tunnels to explore"; while a new drillboat vehicle marks the first seafaring mode of transport to be added to the series. 

In typically off-the-wall Worms fashion, here's some of that in motion:

Free-of-charge, Worms WMD's Liberation update will be made available on December 7. Grab the base game for £19.99/$29.99 via the Humble Store.

Some online stores give us a small cut if you buy something through one of our links. Read our affiliate policy for more info.

notes.title: Windows, Mac & Linux Cross-Play Beta: Sign up now for this Friday!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/3b1558a8767cbcaefb7793a30c50a8e495a52c58.gif[/img]
Hey Community,

The time has come to announce the dates for our Worms W.M.D Cross-Play Beta! 

[b]Platforms and Timings[/b]

The Cross-Play Beta will be launched with the aim to bring together Worms W.M.D players from the following platforms:
[list]
[*]Windows
[*]Mac
[*]Linux
[/list]
The Beta will start at 10am GMT on Friday 25th (this Friday) and run until 10am GMT on Tuesday 29th.


[b]How do I sign up?[/b]

Good news, this is an open Beta so all are welcome! There’s no password required to get access to the Beta, however you will need to access a different branch of Worms W.M.D. The good news is, this is really simple to do, even if you’ve never done it before. We’ve got the process below for you:
[list]
[*]Right click on Worms W.M.D in the players game library
[*]Select Properties > Betas
[*]Open the drop down list under ‘Select the beta you would like to opt into:’
[*]Select “beta”
[*]Select ‘CLOSE’ in the properties window
[*]Allow Worms W.M.D to update to the Beta version
[*]Launch Worms W.M.D
[/list] 
Then all you need to do is play as normal!

[b]Linux users – Make sure you’re up to date![/b]

We just need you to make sure that you’ve got your drivers up to date and that GL version 3.3 installed. If you’re not up to date you’ll be grab them through the manufacturer’s drivers. We’ve had to make this change as the minimum version of OpenGL had to be updated to get Cross-Play working.


[b]How do I report bugs/give feedback?[/b]

In order to give the most direct, quality feedback straight to the development team we’re going to need our budding Beta testers to report to us on the Team17 Mantis database. 

You can sign up to Mantis and find out all the information on how to report bugs by following this [url=https://mantispub.team17.com/login_page.php]LINK.[/url]

By giving us feedback on the feature here it will greatly increase the speed at which we can make sure the feature is working as intended and we can roll it out as a fully-fledged, permanent feature to the main game branch. 


[b]What can I do before the Beta?[/b]

Start talking to each other, Mac & Linux players make yourself known. Windows players, if you know any Mac/Linux players give them a prod. Agree some timings where you’ll be on at the same time so you can have a good cross platform battle. Feel free to use this thread to do this.

[u]When you’re playing on the Beta branch you will be on a separate server to the main game and will not be matched with those who aren’t participating in the Beta.[/u] 

Not only does this serve as a reminder that if you want to play some normal games, switch back to the normal branch, but highlights the importance of sorting out some matchups beforehand. 

If you have any questions please feel free to leave a post.

Thank you for your support with this, we’re excited to start the process of unifying the Worms W.M.D Community in glorious battle.

You can sign up to Mantis and find out all the information on how to report bugs by following this [url=https://mantispub.team17.com/login_page.php]LINK.[/url]

By giving us feedback on the feature here it will greatly increase the speed at which we can make sure the feature is working as intended and we can roll it out as a fully-fledged, permanent feature to the main game branch. 


[b]What can I do before the Beta?[/b]

Start talking to each other, Mac & Linux players make yourself known. Windows players, if you know any Mac/Linux players give them a prod. Agree some timings where you’ll be on at the same time so you can have a good cross platform battle. Feel free to use this thread to do this.

[u]When you’re playing on the Beta branch you will be on a separate server to the main game and will not be matched with those who aren’t participating in the Beta.[/u] 

Not only does this serve as a reminder that if you want to play some normal games, switch back to the normal branch, but highlights the importance of sorting out some matchups beforehand. 

If you have any questions please feel free to leave a post.

Thank you for your support with this, we’re excited to start the process of unifying the Worms W.M.D Community in glorious battle.

notes.title: Global Chat is Now Live For Windows Players!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/de5da7f4d81dcfd9c051e5714012ba18a741c855.gif[/img]

Hey Community

The time has come for the rollout of Global Chat to begin. We've got all the details below to get you up to speed on how the new feature works so tuck in:


- Global Chat for Windows is here! Don’t worry OSX and Linux users, we haven’t forgot about you and we’re working on getting this out for you too as soon as we can. 

To access Global Chat, all you need to do is click on the speech bubble in the bottom right of the main menu, and you’ll be logged straight in. It’s as easy as that! From here, you’ll be able to chat to your fellow players, arrange battles against your friends / enemies / fellow annelids and wage war! 

We’ve made it as easy as possible for you to switch between Global and Lobby chat too, simply by opening the tabs which can be selected from the side of the chat panel.

We've also squished out a couple of initial bugs, but if you find any lurking please let us know!

- Fixed an issue which prevented the Tilde key from functioning correctly.
- Fixed an issue which caused camera issues when using arrow keys in the classic default controls.

So go forth and chat! Organise games, make new buddies and challenge all who dare cross your Wormy path.

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Patch Notes - Build 1.4!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/3b50e107fe784dfe4e4086307c054904cc5e3a0d.gif[/img]

Hey Everyone,

You might’ve seen in the forums that we’ve started a monthly community roadmap to show you what we’ll be working on with Worms W.M.D each month. Today’s update brings with it a host of fixes to improve performance for the Community.

[h1]Windows Update [/h1] [b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where worms would slide when using the parachute
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented players using the last selected weapon after exiting a vehicle
[*]Fixed an issue which showed a gap in imported levels
[*]Fixed an issue which could prevent players from selecting team colours
[*] Fixed an exploit which allowed players to teleport outside of a cavern
[*]Fixed an issue where the commentary panel would appear after quitting an online match
[*]Fixed an issue which could prevent a restart from the results screen
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented the input language updating correctly
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented Single Player missions from starting if the chat window was left open at the end of an online match
[*]Fixed an issue which could cause loss of input on both keyboard and controller when the chat window is left open after an online match
[*] Fixed an issue which changes the key bindings when using NumLock
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented symbols from being used in chat
[*]Additional fix when using Alt+F4 so the game can be closed
[*] Players can now quit LMP games in the mid round lobby
[*]Replays will now fade in and fade out
[*] Teleport in now has the correct audio effect
[*] The speed for the commentary text has been increased
[*] Tweaked AI threat value so it will target the biggest threat instead of going after the player all the time…sneaky Worms!!
[*]Ninja Rope will now correctly play the correct audio when attaching to the landscape
[/list]
[/b]

Tweaks
- Tweak to minigun
- Tweak to Bunker Buster when used on magnets

Roadmap Updates

At the start of the month we started our Community Roadmap to keep you in the loop with our plans for the month and to get your feedback. So, let’s give you an update on what’s what shall we!

[i]Global Chat[/i] – We were progressing at full steam with Global Chat and had originally had planned to have it released by now. Unfortunately we ran into a small hurdle of getting hold of a licence holder that would enable us to go live with the systems we wanted. Because of this we’ve had to explore other options that are now going through our QA process. We hope to have global chat seeing the light of day as soon as our QA team have signed it off. 

Global Chat will be releasing on the Windows version of Worms W.M.D first with roll out to the other platforms once we know everything is working as intended. 

[i]Cross-Play Beta[/i] – We’re still on track with this to be functional by the end of the month, subject to nothing going wrong of course.

[i]Craftable Weapon Scheme[/i] – Due to the slight bump in the plans for Global Chat we prioritised that and reassigned extra development time to addressing the issue that had arisen there. Once everything is resolved in Global Chat we’ll be pushing on with the craftable weapons scheme.

We’ve got more updates coming before the end of the month so stay tuned for more news.

Join the patch discussion over on the forums [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/327030/discussions/0/333656722970163341/]now.[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/31421f01d7c542af24d24d564fbb071a56d8d4b7.gif[/img]

Hey Community,

This Saturday heralds the third Worms W.M.D ESL Tournament!

SIGN UP NOW: [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/new-games/pc/worms-wmd/open/community-cup-3/]ESL Tournament Page[/url]

Will you be able to take down  2x Chamption Rantsi or will they get the Hat Trick?

As promised we've worked closely with yourselves and ESL to continue crafting competitive Worms W.M.D into it's best possible form. So, starting this Saturday the following changes have been made to the match scheme:

•Round Time: 20 -> 15

•Retreat Time: 5 -> 3

•Girder Radius Restriction: Off -> On

•Jetpack Fuel: 100 -> 50

•Rope Swings: 5 -> 3

•Mines: Some -> Lots

•Mounted Guns: None -> Few

•Anti_Tank Mines: None -> Few

•Weapon Drop: 10% -> 5%

•Utility Drop: 10% -> 5%

•Health Drop: 10% -> 5%

•Craft Drop: 0% -> 5%

•Vehicle Drop: 0% -> 5%

•Cluster Bomb: Ammo 4 -> 6

•Banana Bomb: Ammo 1 - Delay 5 - Crates On -> 0 - 0 - Off

•Holy Hand Grenade: Ammo 1 - Delay 4 - Crates On -> 0 - 0 - Off

•Shotgun: Ammo 4 -> 2

•Sentry Gun: Ammo 0 - Delay 0 - Crates Off -> 1 - 3 - On

•Baseball Bat: Delay 2 -> 4

•Electromagnet: Ammo 0 - Crates Off -> 2 - On

•Girder: Ammo 1 -> 2

•Dynamite: Delay 0 -> 4

•Mine: Ammo 3 -> 2

•Sheep: Crates On -> Off

•Old Lady: Ammo 1 - Delay 3 - Crates On -> 0 - 0 - Off

•Airstrike: Delay 3 - Crates On -> 6 - Off

•Homing Missile: Crates On -> Off

•Sheep On A Rope: Ammo 1 -> 0

•Dodgy Phone Battery: Crates Off -> On

•Unwanted Present: Crates Off -> On

•Ninja Rope: Ammo 4 -> 3

•Crafting has to be disabled (off) -> Crafting enabled (on)

•Boggy's Special Sauce - Some

•Sticky Donkey Paste - Few 

•Banana Bomb Seeds - Few

•Tears of a Worm - None


It's worth noting we will continue to take onboard your feedback, so expect further changes in the near future if required. 

Once we have a final scheme the majority are happy with we'll be introducing prizes and haven't written off the potential for of what they could be if the tournaments become popular enough.

The future of competitive Worms W.M.D is in your hands. Even if you're not overly keen on the scheme at this stage your participation will show ESL the want is there and we can push through further scheme changes for future tournaments.

For those partaking, may the Bazookas be ever in your favour.

notes.title: Team17 & Boggy need your help with Worms W.M.D feedback
notes.notes:
[h1]EDIT - SURVEY IS NOW CLOSED[/h1]
Hey Teamsters! The survey will be closing today after being up for a week. I would like to give a big thank you to everyone who took part. Your feedback is very much appreciated.

Winners of the prize draw will receive an email in about 10-14 days time. Please remember to check your Spam inbox just in case.

Take care everyone and enjoy Worms W.M.D!

Janey <(T<)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Teamsters! We need your help![/h1]
You've had the opportunity to play Worms W.M.D for a while now, and we'd love for you to share your thoughts about the game. Whether you love it, are not sure about it, or just want to craft ridiculously OP weapons to annihilate your friends, let us know what you think about existing content, what you would like to see, and what is not quite working for you.

[h1]This link will take you to the survey, hosted by Google Forms.[/h1]
[url]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUFkYotT3eQhGz8JCfaM7GEMnNb6Xct5Yt7YzFXCKOxv3KkQ/viewform[/url]

[h1]What happens to my feedback?[/h1]
All feedback will be passed on to the development team, and used to improve some of the game's features. 

[h1]Also, you need to know that ...[/h1]
[list]
[*]We will ask for your email address so we can contact you should you win a prize (if you opt in to the prize draw).
[*]The survey should take approximately 5-10 minutes (comment boxes excluded).
[*]The comment boxes are optional in case you want to add more information. Write as much or as little as you want.
[/list]

[h1]Prizes![/h1]
We appreciate completing surveys takes time.
[list]
[*]At the end of the survey there will be an option to enter the prize draw, with the opportunity to win one of three Worm-tastic loot bags.
[*]You get double the chance to win by telling us your most memorable Worm story ever. The top three stories that make the Producer and Lead Designer laugh the most will be shared for the world to see on the Team17 usability webpage - https://www.team17.com/usability/
[/list]

If you experience any survey problems, or want to send me more info/Worms stories, email me (Janey) at usability@team17.com. I guarantee I read every email, and will pass on all comments to the development team.

Thanks so much for helping out!

Janey_Team17 <(T<)

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Community Roadmap - October!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/2d9b80f19dba62b48243fea4724a395f29f0db2f.gif[/img]

Starting right now we're going to be introducing a monthly Community Roadmap!

The aim of the roadmap will be to keep you all in the loop regarding our plans for the game in the coming month, promote upcoming events and engage with you directly about new features that are in the pipeline. 

By bringing you closer to the development process and our vision, we aim to continue crafting and building upon Worms W.M.D to support you and make Worms W.M.D the best Worms game yet.

So, things are pretty exciting update wise this month so let's get stuck in:


[h1][b]Global Chat[/b][/h1]

Many of you have asked for it and now it's almost here! Global Chat will allow players to chat to other online Worms W.M.D players and bring the online community closer together. 

Whether you want to promote your custom scheme game, make friends or just chat Worms then Global Chat will allow you to do that. 

Global Chat is also bringing a full UI change to the chat system. This will make chat much clearer using a 'tab' system rather than the little phone icon. This also means you'll be able to see the full lobby screen without the chat box covering up the important stuff.


[h1][b]Allowing 5 craftable weapons in the game as a scheme setting[/b][/h1]

Worms W.M.D hailed the arrival of craftable weapons, a whole new mechanic to let players customise their play style and react turn to turn on the battlefield with powerful new weapons and tools.

However, these weren't available for custom schemes from launch, but later this month you'll be able to pre-select 5 craftable weapons to be part of your starting loadout as if they were standard weapons.

We've had to limit this feature to 5 weapons for now so that we could get the feature live early. We have plans to expand this feature to full customisation on craftable/standard weapons in your match schemes, but, this is quite a big UI undertaking so will be coming in phases.

So from Ropers to fans of fancy weapons, your freedom in creating your ideal match is nearly here!


[h1][b]Patches, including bug fixes and tweaking[/b][/h1]

Exactly what is says on the tin!

We'll be watching the game very closely whether it's bugs, balance or a slight increase to the Worm plop sound. You can expect our support as we continue to refine the core game.


[h1][b]Cross Play in Beta between the Windows, Mac and Linux Steam builds[/b][/h1]

CROSS PLAY IS COMING!

We'll be holding a Beta this month to prepare us for a smooth launch of this much desired feature. This will then bring Windows, Mac & Linux players together to see who will reign supreme. 

Of course we'll be wanting your help with this, so if you're on one of those platforms, do keep a lookout & make yourself known to us so you can pave the way with us!


That's October! We'd love to hear what you think of what's coming in the October Roadmap official thread [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/327030/discussions/0/343787920140842217/]here.[/url]

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Patch Notes - Build 1.3!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/c92198d0da74ef9579002239ba25f64247dc0a4c.gif[/img]

Hello Community,

Bug fixes, weapon tweaks and more - it's patch time!
[list]
[*]Fix to allow the Parachute to be selected using F keys whilst on Ninja Rope
[*]Fixed the delay when cancelling replays and position of the camera when returning to gameplay
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented players from using utilities in the final second of their turn
[*]Fixed a bug where a particle would be seen during a replay following a crate explosion
[*]Fixed a bug where controllers were detected following a disconnect
[*]Fixed a bug where stats weren’t always updated correctly following a draw
[*]Fixed a bug which was sometimes preventing a game from being found if a host lost their connection
[*]Fixed a bug which was preventing issues on the UI in the editor after publishing
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented some animations from being triggered correctly
[*]Made improvements to the camera so it will correctly show damages to worms
[*]Made improvements to the post process effects on weapons
[*]Players will no longer search indefinitely after failing to join a previous lobby
[*]Made a tweak to the Parachute whilst on the Ninja Rope
[*]Tweaked the size of the collision on the vehicles
[*]Team health bars will now be visible during the hotseat timers
[*]Improved the matchmaking experience for when multiple players are searching at similar times
[*]Prevented multiple dialog boxes from appearing following a disconnection
[*]Players will no longer get multiple dialogs after editing a team
[*]Theme names will now be correctly displayed when creating a new lobby after hosting previous match
[*]Community tab will now display a breadcrumb trail whenever new information is posted…..stay tuned folks!
[/list] 
We’ve also made some more tweaks to some of the weapons and utilities following some more feedback that we’ve seen from the community:
 
[b]Air Strike and Demon Strike[/b]
Less chance of hitting the higher end of damage

[b]Ninja Rope[/b]
Correction for worm spin.

[b]Gas weapons[/b]
Fairer initial distribution of gas, environmental factors should still be considered.

[b]Minigun[/b]
More spread on recoil, reducing ability to gain max damage


Oh and one last thing, Global Chat, it's coming rather soon...

notes.title: Sign up for the Second ESL Worms W.M.D Tournament!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/a40db58ae774254046a7375e16b084961927a8b6.gif[/img]

Hey Community,

You put on a fantastic show in the first ESL Worms W.M.D Tournament and because of this they're running a second this Saturday!

Here's the details:

Worms W.M.D (PC) 1on1 Community Cup #2 Europe

Start time: Saturday, 01 Oct 2016 18:30 BST 
Check in time: Saturday, 01 Oct 2016 18:10 BST 
Late sign up: Saturday, 01 Oct 2016 18:20 BST 

How to Participate
Register on ESL
Follow the steps found on the widget found at right side of the page[play.eslgaming.com]
Make sure you confirm your participation (check-in) 20 minutes before the cup start

How to play
Add your opponent as friend on steam
Host a lobby
Invite your opponent to the lobby
Play and report the results at the end of the match


The matches will be played with an [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/new-games/pc/worms-wmd/open/community-cup-2/rules]ESL custom scheme.[/url]

We've been collating your feedback and working closely with ESL craft Worms W.M.D into a competitive experience. This will start with adjusting the scheme used. This may or may not be reflected in this Saturday's tournament due to time constraints.

So make sure to [url=http://play.eslgaming.com/new-games/pc/worms-wmd/open/community-cup-2/rules]sign up[/url] if you want to compete and show off your skills!

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Update! V1.2
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/4d03edcc4216e32d1bee808961772aa99eeac136.gif[/img]

Thanks for the feedback we’ve been getting from you, the Worms community, about how you want Worms W.M.D to continue to evolve. Today’s update brings improvements to performance, bug fixes and a host of balances and tweaks based on the feedback that we’ve been seeing in these forums. 

Here’s the full list of changes:

[h1]Balances and Tweaks[/h1][b]
- Vehicles will now randomly spawn in (5% chance) during Ranked matches instead of at the beginning of the match
- Slightly lowered health of the helicopter (-5 Health)
- Sound of the worm plop increased
- Secondary weapon fuses can now be altered
- The camera will now follow the Sentry Gun Lite when it’s thrown
- Any items under water during sudden death will no longer be visible
- User Generated Content can now be refreshed with a controller
- Girder can now be rotated by holding down a binded key

notes.notes:
I must confess that, despite my tiny, shrivelled heart, I feel a wee bit sorry for Team 17. For over 20 years they ve been pitting wriggly, pun-loving invertebrates against each other in turn-based cartoon wars, while making considerable changes to the formula, but all anyone really seems to want is another Worms Armageddon. If you are one of the 7 billion people living on Earth: good news, because Worms W.M.D. [official site] is what you ve been asking for.

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/6f4528ae3a99cced7e5cae008a9a93172c8fe3b6.gif[/img]

Hi all,

Hope everyone is having a great weekend!

We've had confirmation from Valve that they've fixed the "Missing Content Manifest" that a few of you were seeing. 

So we've now repushed the patch live for you. Please find below the update notes for Update 1.

Happy worming!

_______________________________________________________________



Hey there Worm Commanders!

You've been battling away furiously since Tuesday and already many Worms have perished...

From your battles we have been taking on-board your feedback and comments as we continue our plans to make Worms W.M.D the definitive Worms experience.

Today's update focuses on quality of experience and addresses the 'Ranked Mode' points system, game crashes and a certain Jetpack audio bug among other things. Read the full update notes below:

[list]
[*]A fix has been made to the editor whereby a sprite sheet could be seen when zoomed in
[*]Fixed a crash in the editor when selecting ‘New’ after having already imported an image
[*]Fixes a crash in the editor when selecting refresh
[*]Steam overlay not closing when viewing leaderboards on Linux
[*]Fixed debug text appearing when a map can’t be downloaded
[*]Fix to an issue where players Ranked Points weren’t being updated correctly 
[*]Fixed OSX and Linux from going into sleep mode whilst the game is running
[*]Fix to the unsaved changes dialog appearing when typing Z or X after making an edit
[*]Fixed an issue where cancelling to host a game would affect local lobbies
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could crash when pressing F4
[*]Fix to the issue where audio could get stuck after a replay
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming!

We'll see you on the battlefield.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Worms W.M.D
notes.notes:
Worms W.M.D is Now Available on Steam!

The worms are back in their most destructive game yet. With a gorgeous, hand-drawn 2D look, brand new weapons, the introduction of crafting, vehicles and buildings plus the return of some much-loved classic weapons and gameplay, Worms W.M.D is the best worms experience ever.

notes.title: Worms W.M.D is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/2d9b80f19dba62b48243fea4724a395f29f0db2f.gif[/img]

[h1]We're Mighty Dangerous![/h1]

The worms are back in their most destructive game yet. With a gorgeous, hand-drawn 2D look, brand new weapons, the introduction of crafting, vehicles and buildings plus the return of some much-loved classic weapons and gameplay, Worms W.M.D is the best worms experience ever. 

Work your way through 30 campaign levels of increasing difficulty using the huge arsenal of new and classic weapons at your disposal. Use new vehicles to cause chaos amongst the enemy ranks and use buildings to gain the tactical advantage as you try to dominate the battlefield! 

Take on up to five opponents in hilarious all-out tactical worm warfare with up to eight worms each, either in local or online multiplayer, including ranked play. Flatten your opponents with the Concrete Donkey. Turn them into chunks of worm meat with the Holy Hand Grenade. Rain down hell from above in helicopters or pound them into oblivion with the tank. With 80 weapons and utilities at your fingertips, this is Worms at its chaotic best!

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/327030/ss_fac3d7c247f1d1bbd80fb4d67657c4c325e31354.1920x1080.jpg?t=1471967776/img]

[h1]Join us live on stream tonight![/h1]

To celebrate the launch of Worms W.M.D we're going to be hosting an epic 2 hour stream at 6:30pm BST.

Join us to watch the action unfold, take us on at Worms W.M.D and enter our competitions to win exclusive Worms W.M.D loot including plushies, key-rings and badges!

Join us here: www.twitch.tv/team17ltd at 6:30pm BST and be part of the action

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/c92198d0da74ef9579002239ba25f64247dc0a4c.gif[/img]
[b]Thank you to everyone that has followed Worms W.M.D since we announced it last year. Your support and enthusiasm has been simply amazing. We really hope that you enjoy the game![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/327030/

But that’s not all…

We’re celebrating the launch of Worms W.M.D by gathering up our friends from across gaming for the Worms W.M.D All-Stars Pre-Order.

[h1]All gamers pre-ordering the game before its August 23rd launch will receive the following Worms W.M.D All-Stars content:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/53fe3101ed7520c111a4f15c4730c2f4cd9ec066.png[/img]
Worms fans worldwide are eager to cause mayhem with the all-new, mega-powerful Tank in Worms W.M.D., but wait until they get their hands on the Rocket League Octane Battle-Car! Soccer meets driving meets Worms. What's not to like? 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/389dc6d93f6775005157aa52d295946876a8c2e4.png[/img]
Use the Goat-on-a-Rope weapon to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as the goat swings around the gorgeous digitally painted 2D landscapes using its sticky tongue to hone in on them! Laugh maniacally as the homicidal maniac with hooves explodes, turning your opponents’ troops into worm meat! We also have a pretty cool Goat Simulator three mask set. Because, why not?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/398c5a82f34250edaa6f22dfa10085f108579854.png[/img]
It’s Payday time for the worms. Stick it to the man by dressing your invertebrate chums up in the masks that have become iconic for millions of PAYDAY 2 fans around the world and plan your attack looking like a total badass. They’ll never take you alive!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/a8424b93fe3d1c62be3a2d887a6b11046352bc6e.png[/img]
The most outrageous, over-the-top action franchise in videogames, arrives in Worms W.M.D in the form of the Dubstep gun from Saints Row IV. This baby can inflict massive damage whilst making pedestrians (and worms) dance. Yes, dance. Team17 is proud, and slightly nervous, to announce that the Dubstep Gun will be bringing the dance-pocalypse as one of our mounted guns in honour of this awesome weapon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/85a3d67f49416d5659a0a77a121799ba71374a2e.png[/img]
The free-to-play zombie survival sensation, where millions of users try their best to stay alive, shuffles into Worms W.M.D in search of brains! And in homage to this popular zomb-fest, Worms fans can dress their slimy pals in a three mask set and wage war in an Unturned mission.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/aa4bfc8437646b11c277d87977949460b0eb41e2.png[/img]
Coming to the explosive rescue of worms everywhere is the fan favourite Broforce Turkey Bomb, bringing the pain in Worms W.M.D. And that’s not all! The Liberty Strike is a Broforce flavoured airstrike which will rain down fiery hell from the skies. Booyah!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/dc5d2b3dd18267fda21a0b8715ce52a591e5788a.png[/img]
The War Mage and Sorceress have vowed to protect the world and guard the rifts. But sometime after the last great battle, trouble is brewing again. Whilst we wait for the Orc Invasion, we can dress our worms up in this Orcs Must Die! three mask set and unleash the excellent crafted minions weapon. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/2ed7e07b19bf5534eba34a2a6d065dd7bbf70da9.png[/img]
Dress your worms up as one of gaming’s most anticipated double acts with the awesome Yooka-Laylee seven mask set!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/03a738b9e2cf0bec42389fc5f2d846499941e09a.png[/img]
A three mask set from the award-winning 2015 hit The Escapists is a must-have accessory for all wormy wannabe escapists. And if you want somewhere different to escape to, there’s a new mission waiting for you. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/43858b4dbc47fd2f4c2b84a73554c8dc1de9c36c.png[/img]
Ahhhh, precious memories of mutually-assured worm destruction! Don’t you just wish you could re-live them? We’ve got you covered! Unleash the Ming Vase, Sheep Launcher and Kamikaze weapons, get stuck into five classic missions and head into battle in a classic Worms three mask set!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/9dfbb66eb946d85f72cda0c30c5eecc68b443eb2.png[/img]
TF2 brings the worm pain with the devastating Sentry Gun weapon and nine mask set featuring the full TF2 crew of Pyro, Demoman, Medic, Spy, Soldier, Scout, Sniper, Heavy and Engineer. 

[h1]See all of this in action in the All-Stars Pre-Order Trailer[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kb0vMfcE9-o

[h1]Stop by the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/327030/discussions/]Worms W.M.D forum[/url] to let us know what you think of the All-Stars Pre-Order. And if you liked the announcement please give it a big thumbs up![h1]

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Crafting Reveal!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/d0a1cb211e5ff339e7ec16d703679492c4d11f50.gif[/img]
[h1]Welcome to a new way to play Worms![/h1]

For the first time ever you’ll be able to adapt to situations on the fly by crafting an assortment of fittingly crazy weapons.

Collecting the brand new crafting crates will give you access to 4 wonderful ingredients to craft your new favourite weapons. Short of ingredients? Dismantle the weapons you don’t plan on using and craft your way to victory!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/6ee7e07dfe2702b8dc9979a9453dc1ce99bf57e5.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Introducing the 4 ingredients:[/h1][b]

•             Boggy’s Special Sauce

•             Sticky Donkey Paste

•             Banana Bomb Seeds

•             Tears of a Worm[/b]

[h1]And there’s more![/h1]

Whilst you’re waiting for that friend of yours that takes forever to do anything, you can have your hands busy crafting. Yep, that’s right, Worms W.M.D will let you dismantle and craft weapons during the enemies turn. Which of course means that they’ll likely be crafting during yours.

[b]See crafting in action in our E3 Worms trailer:[/b] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JjGjDf_YzzI

[h1]We want to know what you think of crafting so stop by the Worms W.M.D forum and say hello!

And be sure to add Worms W.M.D to your Steam Wishlist: http://store.steampowered.com/app/327030/

If you liked the announcement please give it a thumbs up![/h1]

notes.notes:

[h1]In episode one of this brand new miniseries we discuss the cornerstone of any Worms game, it's multiplayer.[/h1]

From weapons to rivalries, no stone is left unturned in this video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdRiCx_LyEE

[b]Add Worms W.M.D to your Steam Wishlist: [/b]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/327030/
[h1]Worms W.M.D is coming to London Comic Con[/h1]

We’re excited to let you all know that our friends over at Xbox Achievements have invited us to take over the Resero Games Stage to show off Worms W.M.D. Me (Danny) and Team17’s other Community Manager Jonno will be playing some Worms Multiplayer up on stage. We’ll have some surprises up our sleeves for those that come to watch! We’ll be onstage at 4pm on Saturday 28th May. 

[h1]Overcooked joins the Team17 Games Label[/h1]

We’re also super excited to announce Team17’s partnership with Cambridge based independent developer Ghost Town Games to publish the chaotic, couch co-op cooking game, Overcooked, on Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and PC.
 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/448510/
The Onion Kingdom is in danger and only the finest cooking can save it! In Overcooked players must journey through a variety of cruel and unusual kitchens on their quest to become master chefs capable of conquering an ancient edible evil which plagues the land. Play solo or engage in classic, chaotic couch co-op for up to four players in both co-operative and competitive challenge modes. You’ll have to cook a range of different dishes and work together in order to become the most effective and ultimate team! 
Overcooked will be heading to Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and PC later this year. You can check out the tastiest trailer in town below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J39h5o-m1EI

notes.title: Introducing Worms: Dating Revolution
notes.notes:
[img=https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/websitepng3.png]
[h1]The Worms are no stranger to war, but the time has come for them to take to the toughest battlefield of all. The battlefield of love.[/h1]

Become a lover, not a fighter in the newest addition to the Worm franchise. After a near death experience being injured on the front lines by Banana Bomb shrapnel you wake up in hospital, Granny looking down on you. A sudden realisation courses through you as you realise there’s more to life that war. 

Set out into Wormville and get your wiggle on as you begin your search for a soulmate. Meet the locals, flirt, date and take on love rivals as you journey your romantic quest. Will you achieve romance, or be a dating Armageddon? Find out in Worms: Dating revolution.

[img=https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/websitepng2.png]
[h1]Featuring exciting features you’ll love such as:[/h1][b]
•	Be the Worm - Create and customize your own unique Worm from over 1 Million variations, no two Worms the same!
•	Woo your love interests in blistering 60fps 1080p!
•	Multiple endings with a branching story, you’ll want to come back for more.
•	Variety is the spice of life - Date Worms, Super Sheep, Bazookas and even the mythical Concrete Donkey
•	Local & Online Multiplayer – Compete with your friends and strangers to become the ultimate Love Guru invertebrate.
•	Love has no boundaries – Cross Platform play enabled![/b]

[img= https://www.team17.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Websitepng1.png]

[h1]Coming to Xbox One, PlayStation 4, PC, Mobile and Virtual Boy on 1st April 2017![/h1]

[b] If you liked the post please give it a thumbs up![/b]
